rationale: Restores room recognition and ordinary room saves for closed contours affected by stored T-incidence and derived-cut identity disagreement in v1.83.0. Optimize aligns connected structural contacts together and preserves hosted openings. Narrow backend proofs accept only lossless carrier promotion and ownership of existing exact wall identities; stale-client, real-gap and host-corruption refusals remain. No new UI, settings, schema or coordinate-model migration. Owner requested patch-only 1.83.1; new Optimize diagnostics are deferred to #1170.

summary.ru: Комнаты создаются в допустимых замкнутых контурах сразу после обновления, без предварительного Optimize. Оптимизация сохраняет примыкания стен и проёмы и не вызывает связанную ошибку сохранения.
summary.en: Create rooms in valid closed contours immediately after updating, without running Optimize first. Optimize preserves wall contacts and openings and avoids the related save error.
